caseName: Wong Kwai Sing ex rel. Wong Lum Sang v. Dulles
caseNameFull: Wong Kwai Sing, by his next friend, Wong Lum Sang v. Dulles, Secretary of State
attorneys: Verne' O. Warner for petitioner. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Wilkey, Beatrice Rosenberg and Felicia Dubrovsky for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion to dispense with printing the petition and motion to. substitute .Christian A. Herter in the place of John Foster Dulles, deceased, granted. Motion to prepare and circulate copies of the record denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
